class PeerReceiverBase226 {
    public string $text;

        global $owner;
        $this->text = $value;
        return $owner->MiSsInG(first: false, later: (
            \Closure::fromCallable([$this, 'capture'])
        )($value, peerShift226()));

    public function capture($saved, $marker) {
        $this->text = $saved;
        echo 'CAPTURE:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';';
        return $this;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'THIS-END;'; }
}
class PeerReceiverChild226 extends PeerReceiverBase226 {}

    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; }
}
